acquisition_rows.policy_block: Yes, Saint Kate is a pet-friendly hotel, with a maximum of two pets allowed. Well-behaved dogs are always welcome. Other pets may be allowed with prior approval – please contact the hotel before booking your stay to discuss your options. At Saint Kate, we offer dog treats, dog bowls, and beds based on availability. There is a pet cleaning fee of $100 per stay. Our friendly staff can assist with arranging a third-party dog walking or potty service if needed. Some things to remember when traveling with your dog to our pet-friendly hotel – Saint Kate requires that dogs be on-leash at all times when traveling through public spaces. Please be courteous and clean up your dog's waste accordingly. Pets should not be left unattended in your room for long periods of time. When a pet is left unattended in your room, please hang the "Pet Inside" door hanger on your exterior door handle. Pets are not allowed in the Milwaukee Center Galleria and should always use the front entrance of the hotel. Please contact Guest Services for more information on bringing your furry companion to stay at Saint Kate.
